hypothesis: The exact v51 SP500/SPCX live-v3 route may retain an attributable after-cost edge only when source-native observer decisions reach the backend without internal coverage gaps and complete lifecycles occur on both configured sides.

evidence.role: immutable extended current-run backend-observer parity through 06:15 UTC
validated but undeployed post-start observer recovery proposal

data_quality.interpretation: All 116 present decisions are field-identical across observer and backend. The historical two-hour joint gap keeps end-to-end parity unresolved, but no new boundary gap or divergence appeared after recovery.

current_run_findings.interpretation: The current process has not skipped an attributable index trade; no completed decision satisfied the frozen v3 entry contract.

compatible_profile_history.interpretation: These three exact-v51 lifecycles remain compatible profile evidence but are not outcomes from the current process window or independent samples. No exact v51 long lifecycle exists for either index.

decision: Keep the exact v51 index parameters unchanged. Attribute the current absence of index trades to zero eligible completed signals rather than routing failure. Continue uninterrupted prospective collection; do not pool the prior process window as current-run evidence or tune from two SPCX shorts and one SP500 short.

recommendation.Recommendation: Continue the frozen v51 index route and exact boundary audit, prioritizing the first attributable SPCX long lifecycle and then SP500 long-side evidence.
recommendation.Why now: The longer current-run window adds 38 reconciled symbol-decisions without a mismatch, but neither index produced an eligible signal and compatible economics remain short-only and sparse.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Immutable 134-boundary parity report, 116 exact present comparisons, historical gap diagnostics, current-run observer decisions, three prior-process compatible lifecycles, and the validated undeployed supervisor proposal.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: Transport is exact when observations exist; entry scarcity and side-incomplete economics, not a confirmed routing defect, are now the binding research constraints.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Source-native completed-15m index breakout-pressure onsets with EMA21/55 alignment and causal pre-close depth-10 pressure no older than 15 seconds.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Loosen the breakout or pressure threshold, infer shorts are broken from two SPCX outcomes, count pre-v51 long observer signals as current-run trades, remove index routes, or continue the frozen trial with exact attribution.
recommendation.Expected upside: Preserve unbiased live-source evidence and distinguish genuine opportunity scarcity from transport loss before changing a potentially useful route.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Signals may remain sparse; another observer gap may suppress entries; prior short results may be normal variance or a weak mechanism; and the first long outcome may be an outlier.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact current profile/run/provider binding; immutable prefix hashes; 116 field-identical decisions; explicit accounting for 18 historic joint gaps; zero unattributed current-run eligible signals; exact prior-process lifecycle separation.
recommendation.Validation still required: At least one fully resolved source-native long lifecycle per index for diagnosis, additional independent short lifecycles, exact costs and exit attribution, largest-winner sensitivity, continuous boundary coverage, and archive/live source-parity resolution.
recommendation.Success metrics: Zero new unexplained missing boundaries; zero field mismatches; explicit action or non-action attribution for every eligible signal; protected and reconciled lifecycles on both sides; and positive side-separated after-cost economics robust to largest-winner removal when the sample permits.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Escalate on a new boundary gap, eligible observer signal without backend action or exact non-action, unprotected position, source-identity mismatch, or a predeclared side-complete sample with persistently adverse after-cost expectancy. No rollback applies because no live change is proposed.
recommendation.Confidence level: High confidence in present-row transport equality and the zero-current-run-signal diagnosis; low confidence in route profitability because compatible live evidence is only three short lifecycles across a prior process window.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Maintain uninterrupted source-native SPCX capture through the first eligible long and complete exit, then perform the same side-complete audit for SP500 before changing route economics.
limitations: The 17:00-19:00Z gap contains no observer decisions, so whether a qualifying setup occurred inside it remains unknown.
The backend and independent observer can still share upstream public-data defects.
All three compatible index lifecycles came from a prior v51 process window and were shorts.
Zero current-run eligible signals is evidence of signal scarcity over this window, not proof that the strategy will remain sparse.
The supervisor candidate is not deployed and therefore has not yet improved live availability.
No live strategy, route, threshold, exit, sizing, leverage, process, or deployment setting changed.
falsifier: Update this diagnosis if a new current-run observer decision is eligible but lacks matching backend action or explicit non-action, if future present decisions diverge, if another internal boundary gap appears, or when a source-native long lifecycle resolves with complete fills, costs, protection, and exit evidence.
